mapper.select: SELECT om.ORDERNUMBER, om.BUILD, om.SPEC, om.CUSTOMER_ADAP, vda.COUNTRY_OF_OPERATION, (SELECT tire.LOAD_INDEX FROM HDOC_REC_DATA_KOLA_TIRE_MASTER tire WHERE tire.TRANS_TS = vda.TRANS_TS LIMIT 1) AS LOAD_INDEX, cha.ACT, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(admod.VARIABLE SEPARATOR ',') FROM HDOC_ADCA_MODIFICATION admod WHERE admod.SERIE = vda.SERIE AND admod.CHNO = vda.CHNR AND admod.STA = '0' ) AS VARIABLE FROM HDOC_REC_DATA_VDA_GENERAL vda INNER JOIN HDOC_REC_DATA_OM om ON vda.SERIE = om.SERIE AND vda.CHNR = om.CHNR LEFT JOIN HDOC_ADCA_CHANGE cha ON vda.SERIE = cha.SERIE AND vda.CHNR = cha.CHNR WHERE vda.SERIE = #{serie} AND vda.CHNR = #{chnr} LIMIT 1
